prospective_start_rule: Only a publisher release strictly later than the externally registered protocol timestamp can be labelled prospective.
current_sample_status: The sample analyzed before registration is current-vintage retrospective evidence and is not preregistered.

taxonomy_selection.selection_basis: literature-anchored mappings reported jointly; the current-sample declaration is not an externally time-stamped preregistration

source.name: Bank of Japan Time-Series Data Search API
source.series_ids_rule: Freeze every series ID present in mapping metadata series_metadata.

evaluation.claim: Prospective application of the frozen BOJ borrower-composition measurement bridge; not a claim that the current sample established incremental predictability.
evaluation.proxy_outcome_interpretation: Long-term JGB yield change, nominal GDP growth, and BOJ asset growth or acceleration are proxy outcomes rather than direct observations of credit purpose.

outcomes.definition: Forward change in the long-term JGB yield over the forecast horizon, standardized using only the training window available at the forecast origin.
Forward nominal GDP growth over the forecast horizon.
Forward acceleration of BOJ total assets over the forecast horizon.

evaluation.forecast_origin_rule: At each future release, use only observations in the frozen release payload and other outcome-source releases available at that timestamp.
evaluation.training_rule: Expanding window with a common complete-case sample and a minimum of 28 training cases; 20 and 24 cases are declared sensitivity settings.

loss.scale: For each continuous outcome, freeze the training-window standardization at the forecast origin.

revision_policy.predictor_vintages: Never overwrite a captured BOJ payload. A changed payload at the same reported release timestamp is a new linked vintage.
revision_policy.forecast_inputs: Primary forecasts use the first successfully captured payload for each post-registration release; later same-release captures are revision audits.
revision_policy.outcome_realizations: The first official outcome release observed after the target period is primary. Later revisions are retained as separately linked sensitivity scores.
revision_policy.missing_capture: Do not backfill a missed release and label it prospective; record it as a non-primary audit outside the prospective score sequence.
